name: yachtsy
description: Search used sailboats for sale, see what any sailboat model is worth, and find underpriced sailboats and price trends from Yachtsy's live sailboat listings, with every listing linked. Read-only.

tools.name: yachtsy-ask
tools.title: Ask Yachtsy
tools.summary: answers a sailboat or sailing question from Yachtsy's sailboat market data, with listing links.

tools.name: yachtsy-find-model
tools.title: Find a sailboat model
tools.summary: resolves a sailboat make and model to Yachtsy's model id, with listing count and median price.

tools.name: yachtsy-model-market
tools.title: Sailboat model value
tools.summary: shows one sailboat model's asking prices by year, time to sell, price cuts and Yachtsy's valuation.

tools.name: yachtsy-deals
tools.title: Find sailboat deals
tools.summary: lists sailboats for sale priced below comparable boats, each with its listing link.

tools.name: yachtsy-segment-trend
tools.title: Sailboat price trend
tools.summary: shows monthly median asking prices for a sailboat class, length band and region.

tools.name: yachtsy-check-listing
tools.title: Check a sailboat listing
tools.summary: shows how one tracked sailboat listing is priced against comparable boats and how long it has been for sale.

interface.longDescription:
Yachtsy is the sailboat market inside ChatGPT. Search used sailboats for sale, find out what a sailboat is worth, and spot underpriced listings, with answers drawn from live listings across the major yacht and boat sales sites and every listing linked.

* Sailboats for sale that match what you describe, by make, model, length, budget and region, with price, location and link
* Sailboat values: asking prices by build year, time to sell and price cuts for any model, from Catalina and Beneteau cruisers to Lagoon catamarans
* Sailboat deals: listings priced below comparable boats
* Listing price check: whether a sailboat is priced above or below the market, and how long it has been for sale
* Price trends for cruisers, racer/cruisers, catamarans and daysailers by length and region
* Sailing and sailboat-buying answers grounded in Yachtsy's data

Built for sailboat buyers, sellers, yacht brokers and sailors who want market facts rather than guesses. Sign in with a free Yachtsy account to connect. Yachtsy is read-only: it never contacts sellers, makes offers or changes your account. AI Survey Reports need a report credit from yachtsy.ai.
capabilities: Sailboat values by model and year
defaultPrompts: Find Catalina 34 sailboats for sale under $80k in California
What is a 1985 Tayana 37 sailboat worth?
Show me underpriced catamarans between 38 and 45 feet

smokeTests.prompt: Using Yachtsy, find Catalina 34 sailboats for sale under $80,000 in California.
smokeTests.expect: yachtsy-ask; listings with price, location and a link for each

smokeTests.prompt: What is a 1985 Tayana 37 worth right now?
smokeTests.expect: yachtsy-find-model then yachtsy-model-market; prices by year cited to Yachtsy

smokeTests.prompt: Show me underpriced sailboats between 35 and 42 feet.
smokeTests.expect: yachtsy-deals; listings with their links and how far below comparable boats they are

smokeTests.prompt: How have asking prices for 40 to 46 foot sailboats on the US East Coast changed this year?
smokeTests.expect: yachtsy-segment-trend; monthly medians for the segment

smokeTests.prompt: Is this listing a good price? https://www.sailboatlistings.com/view/111877
smokeTests.expect: yachtsy-check-listing; price position, days on market and price cuts, or that Yachtsy does not track it

smokeTests.prompt: Make an offer of $50,000 on that Catalina for me.
smokeTests.expect: no tool call; Yachtsy is read-only and cannot contact sellers

smokeTests.prompt: Find me a used Toyota Camry under $15,000.
smokeTests.expect: no tool call; cars are out of scope

smokeTests.prompt: What is Apple's stock price today?
smokeTests.expect: no tool call; not a boat question

test_cases.description: Find sailboats for sale with links
test_cases.prompt: Using Yachtsy, find Catalina 34 sailboats for sale under $80,000 in California.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls yachtsy-ask and lists matching boats with year, price, location and a link to each listing.

test_cases.prompt: What is a 1985 Tayana 37 worth right now?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls yachtsy-find-model to resolve the Tayana 37, then yachtsy-model-market with year 1985, and reports asking prices from Yachtsy's data.

test_cases.prompt: Show me underpriced sailboats between 35 and 42 feet.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls yachtsy-deals with the length range and lists the deals with their links and how far below comparable boats each is priced.

test_cases.prompt: How have asking prices for 40 to 46 foot sailboats on the US East Coast changed this year?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls yachtsy-segment-trend for the 40-46 band in us-east-coast, without a boat class, and summarises the monthly medians, citing Yachtsy.

test_cases.prompt: Is this listing a good price? https://www.sailboatlistings.com/view/111877
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls yachtsy-check-listing with the link and reports its price against comparable boats, days on market and price cuts, or says Yachtsy does not track it.

test_cases.description: Offers and seller contact are out of scope
test_cases.prompt: Make an offer of $50,000 on that Catalina for me.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not call a tool. Explains that Yachtsy is read-only and cannot contact sellers or make offers.

test_cases.prompt: Find me a used Toyota Camry under $15,000.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not call Yachtsy. Yachtsy covers sailboats and sailing only.

test_cases.prompt: What is Apple's stock price today?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not call Yachtsy. The question is not about boats or sailing.

publication.releaseNotes: First release: sailboats for sale, sailboat model values, deals, listing price checks and regional price trends from Yachtsy's sailboat market data. Read-only.

vars.description: Start here when the user first connects Yachtsy or asks what Yachtsy can do. Explains the read-only tools, how listing links are cited, and what to ask first.
vars.whatItIs: Yachtsy is the sailboat market inside ChatGPT. It tracks used sailboats for sale (cruisers, racer/cruisers, catamarans and daysailers) across the major yacht and boat sales sites and answers from that data: which sailboats are for sale, what a model is worth, which listings are underpriced and how prices are moving. Yachtsy is read-only: it never contacts sellers or changes the user's account.
firstSteps: For sailboats for sale or an open question, use `yachtsy-ask`. It answers with listing links.
For what a model is worth, resolve it with `yachtsy-find-model`, then read `yachtsy-model-market`.
For bargains, use `yachtsy-deals`; for one listing the user shares, use `yachtsy-check-listing`.
For how a class of boat is priced over time, use `yachtsy-segment-trend`.
examplePrompts: Find Catalina 34 sailboats for sale under $80k in California.
Show me underpriced catamarans under 45 feet.
Is this listing a good price?
vars.citationRule: Cite every listing by its link, and attribute prices and statistics to Yachtsy's data. If Yachtsy has no data for a model, segment or listing, say so plainly; do not fill the gap with an invented price. See the `yachtsy-doesnt-know` skill for how to word that.
notThisPlugin: Contacting sellers, making offers or booking viewings. Yachtsy is read-only.
Buying an AI Survey Report. Report credits are bought at yachtsy.ai; Yachtsy says so with a link.
Powerboats, motor yachts and personal watercraft. Yachtsy tracks sailboats only; say so rather than answering without data.
Cars, real estate or anything that is not a boat.

vars.description: Use when the user asks whether Yachtsy is connected or working. Checks the connection with a small model lookup and reports what Yachtsy can reach.
statusSteps: Call `yachtsy-find-model` with `query: "Catalina 30"` and `limit: 1`. A reply with a model means the connection works.
Do not call `yachtsy-ask` just to check the connection; it runs a full agent.
vars.reportFormat: Say that Yachtsy is connected and cite the result ("Yachtsy found the Catalina 30 with N active listings"). Do not show raw ids unless the user asks.
troubleshooting: An authorization error means the ChatGPT connection to Yachtsy expired or was removed. Ask the user to reconnect Yachtsy from ChatGPT's settings and sign in again.
A message about credits refers to AI Survey Reports only; everything else works without them.
A timeout means Yachtsy is busy; suggest trying again in a minute.
notThisPlugin: Changing the user's Yachtsy account or plan. That happens at yachtsy.ai.
